purpose: Index of the versioned Candice protocol schemas. Consumers resolve schema files by logical name; the index is the enumeration the WS-41 contract suite validates against.

protocolSchemas.name: question-event
protocolSchemas.description: Structured governed question delivered to the companion (spec 14).

protocolSchemas.name: answer-event
protocolSchemas.description: The single approved answer returned to the owning Claude session (spec 13.2, 14).

protocolSchemas.name: status-event
protocolSchemas.description: Real session/skill state published to the companion; progress never invented (spec 16).

protocolSchemas.name: preferences
protocolSchemas.description: Local preference profile; never project/conversation memory (spec 9).

protocolSchemas.name: lifecycle-event
protocolSchemas.description: Versioned lifecycle control envelope: activation, question, delivered, answer, cancel, fallback, reconnect, lease, lifecycle state (FIX-013).

protocolSchemas.name: event-envelope
protocolSchemas.description: Shared discriminators (schemaVersion, sessionId, skill, event) documented for all events.

protocolSchemas.name: question-keys
protocolSchemas.description: Validation schema for the stable question key registry.

protocolSchemas.name: question-inventory
protocolSchemas.description: Schema for source doctrine to governed-key traceability.

protocolSchemas.name: question-inventory-data
protocolSchemas.description: Reviewed inventory of active, retired, and zero-governed questions.
